thread:
maria_pm: Quick quarter check — integrations milestone: Connector API GA is targeted for this sprint. Can owners confirm what shipped vs slipped and any blockers? Please ping owners + deps.

alex_lead: Shipped: connector v1.0 feature flags + docs. PR merged: `#4921` (https://git.redwood/pri/4921) :shipit:

alex_lead: Slipped: retry backoff for long-tail errors — saw a perf regression on staging when batch sizes spike. Investigating, suspect KV cache config interaction. Owner: alex_lead.

dinesh_eng: I can pick up the retry backoff fix. Repro when batch_size > 16 causes extra latency. Will try adjusting prefix KV TTL and batching window. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

sam_sre: FYI infra: `kafka-lib` needs 2.3.0 for the new connector features. Staging upgrade is blocked by the schema migration step — @dinesh_eng can you confirm migration approach and downtime risk?

dinesh_eng: Migration requires a consumer bump + short reindex if we do an in-place schema change. Best case: 2-3m pause, or do weekend full reindex/backfill. I'm leaning weekend unless we can do canary cluster.

tia_prod: Product question: if the retry fix slips past the deploy window, can we ship with the retry flag off and enable gradual rollout? Also need a clear rollback plan in the runbook.

alex_lead: Yes — we can gate with `connector_retry_enabled=false` and do a gradual :small_blue_diamond: rollout. Rollback options: flip feature flag or revert PR `#4921`. I'll add runbook steps and quick rollback snippet.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline started for `connector-service` — staging -> canary :rocket:

sam_sre: Watching the pipeline. If we want zero-risk migration I can stand up a canary cluster for the upgrade and route 5% traffic.

maria_pm: Nice. Capturing owners & action items here so I can update the OKR sheet tomorrow morning:
- Alex (alex_lead): add runbook + feature-flag PR by EOD today
- Dinesh (dinesh_eng): implement retry fix + migration plan, ETA EOD tomorrow
- Sam (sam_sre): schedule infra window OR create canary cluster and monitor
- Tia (tia_prod): confirm gating & rollout criteria with PMs

maria_pm: If anyone can't meet the ETA above, reply with a new ETA here. Otherwise I'll mark shipped/slipped in the OKR doc tomorrow AM. Thanks :pray:
